title: OFL-SAM2: Prompt SAM2 with Online Few-shot Learner for Efficient Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: A light mapping network trained on few labelled samples yields target features fused with frozen SAM2 memory attention, prompt-free, with online updates of the mapper during inference over a sequence.
evidence: R: SOTA with limited training data on three medical image segmentation datasets (3D volumes / 2D sequences).
adaptation: Bold bet: treat the cells of one module as a video so SAM2 memory and the online mapper carry what was found in earlier cells of the same module (E1 has 106 cells from 67 modules; pool cells come by module); mapper trained on the 478 cells; aimed at half-cut and scuff context shift.
min_experiment: Module-ordered OFL-SAM2 vs GFDS SAM2 video mode with fixed supports on H36 (ordered by module) and pool half-cells; metric H36 inactive IoU; kill if no gain over fixed-support SAM2.
prior_overlap: Partial: per-panel BN adaptation failed (BRIEF 5), but that is statistic adaptation of the house model, not memory-based propagation across a module.
